dashboard.label: TA-kernel Overview
dashboard.description: Collects kernel crash-readiness and crash signals: kexec crash kernel loaded, kdump service state, kernel taint state, uptime, and counts of NEW oops/panic/BUG lines in the kernel

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="kernel.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="kernel:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
